segments.zh: 胖乎乎的。

segments.en: So chubby, chubbier, chubbiest.
segments.zh: 如此胖乎乎的，胖乎乎的，最胖的。

segments.en: In this case, we're talking about being round or a little bit overweight.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们谈论的是圆形或有点超重。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's not really saying fat.
segments.zh: 所以这不是真正说胖。

segments.en: No, fat is rude.
segments.zh: 不，脂肪是粗鲁的。

segments.en: Chubby is, you know, it's in between.
segments.zh: 胖乎乎的，你知道，它介于两者之间。

segments.en: Just a little bit extra pounds.
segments.zh: 只是一点点额外的磅数。

segments.en: Yeah, like maybe you had a little bit too much ice cream over the past couple months.
segments.zh: 是的，就像在过去的几个月里，你的冰淇淋有点太多了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue for the last time and we'll be back.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不最后一次听对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: Hello, sir.
segments.zh: 您好，先生。

segments.en: How may I help you?
segments.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

segments.en: I would like to buy some flowers, please.
segments.zh: 我想买些花。

segments.en: Something really nice.
segments.zh: 很不错的东西。

segments.en: I see.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: May I ask what the occasion is?
segments.zh: 请问您是为什么场合买花呢？

segments.en: It's not really an occasion.
segments.zh: 这不是一个真正的场合。

segments.en: It's more like I'm sorry.
segments.zh: 这更像是我很抱歉。

segments.en: Very well.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: This flower arrangement here is very popular among regretful husbands and boyfriends.
segments.zh: 这里的插花很受遗憾的丈夫和男朋友的欢迎。

segments.en: It has a dozen long stem red roses with a couple of sunflowers and a single orchid that stands out.
segments.zh: 里面有十二枝长茎红玫瑰，配上几枝向日葵，还有一枝醒目的兰花。

segments.en: It includes a small teddy bear to achieve the effect of immediate forgiveness.
segments.zh: 它包括一只小泰迪熊，以实现立即宽恕的效果。

segments.en: I think I'm going to need more than just a dozen red roses and a bear.
segments.zh: 我想我需要的不仅仅是一打红玫瑰和一只熊。

segments.en: What else do you recommend?
segments.zh: 你还推荐什么？

segments.en: Well, this is our I'm sorry I cheated on you package.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是我们的对不起，我欺骗了你的包裹。

segments.en: Two dozen red roses lined with tulips, carnations and lilies.
segments.zh: 两打红玫瑰衬着郁金香、康乃馨和百合。

segments.en: The fragrance and beauty of this flower arrangement is sure to make her forgive you.
segments.zh: 这种插花的香味和美感一定会让她原谅你。

segments.en: I don't think that's going to cut it.
segments.zh: 恐怕这还不够。

segments.en: I need something bigger and better.
segments.zh: 我需要更大更好的东西。

segments.en: I'm sorry, sir, but what exactly did you do?
segments.zh: 对不起，先生，但你到底做了什么？

segments.en: Well, I may have accidentally insinuated that she is getting chubbier.
segments.zh: 好吧，我可能不小心暗示她变得更胖了。

segments.en: Get out of my store, you jerk.
segments.zh: 滚出我的商店，你这个混蛋。

segments.en: All right, so if you make a mistake, like as a guy, right, you give flowers to your girlfriend.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果你犯了一个错误，就像一个男人一样，对了，你给你的女朋友送花。

segments.en: What about women giving flowers to guys?
segments.zh: 女人给男人送花怎么办？

segments.en: Is that common?
segments.zh: 这很常见吗？

segments.en: Do you think that's possible?
segments.zh: 你认为这是可能的吗？

segments.en: Can you do that?
segments.zh: 你能做到吗？

segments.en: I'm sure you can do it, but I don't know if it's as common.
segments.zh: 我相信你能做到，但我不知道它是否常见。

segments.en: Like I think as a guy, I wouldn't really feel comfortable receiving flowers.
segments.zh: 就像我认为作为一个男人，我真的不会觉得接受鲜花感到自在。

segments.en: I mean, I would be touched by the gesture and I would be like, oh, that's really sweet.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，我会被这个手势感动，我会想，哦，那真的很甜蜜。

segments.en: But like flowers, it's a little bit too feminine, I think.
segments.zh: 但就像花一样，我认为它有点太女性化了。

segments.en: Generally, I think it's a one sided thing.
segments.zh: 一般来说，我认为这是一方面的事情。

segments.en: So you can get flowers for your mother or you can get flowers for a friend or if someone, you know, passed away, you can get flowers for their family.
segments.zh: 所以你可以为你的母亲买花，或者你可以为朋友买花，或者如果有人，你知道，去世了，你可以为他们的家人买花。

segments.en: But in a romantic situation, rarely do you get flowers to a guy.
segments.zh: 但在浪漫的情况下，你很少把鲜花送给一个男人。

segments.en: So if you want to say I'm sorry to a guy, what do you give him?
segments.zh: 所以如果你想对一个男人说对不起，你给他什么？

segments.en: Season tickets to his favorite football team.
segments.zh: 他最喜欢的足球队的季票。

segments.en: That works.
segments.zh: 那行得通。

segments.en: Or a game for his PlayStation.
segments.zh: 或者他的 PlayStation 的游戏。

segments.en: A game for his PlayStation or offer him a new coat of paint on his car.
segments.zh: 为他的 PlayStation 打一场比赛，或者在他的车上给他涂上一层新油漆。

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: Have you never given a gift to somebody like saying I'm sorry?
segments.zh: 你从来没有给别人送礼物，比如说对不起吗？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: No, you don't make mistakes.
segments.zh: 不，你不会犯错误。

segments.en: I like to use my words.
segments.zh: 我喜欢用我的话。

segments.en: That's good.
segments.zh: 那很好。

segments.en: Yeah, this is kind of interesting.
segments.zh: 是的，这很有趣。

segments.en: Why do we do this?
segments.zh: 我们为什么要这样做？

segments.en: So why do we give gifts to people as a token or as a demonstration of our regretfulness?
segments.zh: 那么，为什么我们要将礼物作为象征或作为我们遗憾的表现来送礼物呢？

segments.en: Well, can I get personal for a second?
segments.zh: 好吧，我可以让我一秒钟的个性化吗？

segments.en: I just was thinking about this in terms of engagement.
segments.zh: 我只是在参与方面考虑这个问题。

segments.en: So why do people give a ring when they get engaged?
segments.zh: 那么为什么人们在订婚时会给戒指呢？

segments.en: So I think it's because people like things that glitter, you know, it's like distract the woman and she'll say yes.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是因为人们喜欢闪闪发光的东西，你知道，这就像分散女人的注意力，她会说是的。

segments.en: And so it's the similar thing with with flowers and forgiveness.
segments.zh: 因此，鲜花和宽恕也是如此。

segments.en: You say, oh, gosh, these flowers are so beautiful.
segments.zh: 你说，哦，天哪，这些花真漂亮。

segments.en: Of course, I forgive you.
segments.zh: 当然，我原谅你。

segments.en: Oh, they're so pretty.
segments.zh: 哦，他们太漂亮了。

segments.en: They smell so, you know, it's like it's like distraction from the matter at hand.
segments.zh: 他们闻起来很香，你知道，这就像从手头的事情上分心。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Maybe that's it.
segments.zh: 也许就是这样。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: If you disagree with me, please.
segments.zh: 如果你不同意我的观点，请。

segments.en: It was a very wise man who invented this.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常聪明的人发明了这一点。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if you have any questions, doubts or comments, please come to our website, EnglishPod.com and we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您有任何问题、疑问或意见，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，我们将在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye, everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
